description: Your free book and audiobook laboratory. Turn the PDFs you own into chapter-marked M4B audiobooks, read-along books and bilingual editions, on your own machine. Local TTS, AI cleanup and translations, an assistant that runs the library, chat with cited sources. Apple Silicon Mac, Linux, or one Docker container on a headless server.
